samples.question: The green ring marks the starting emblem. Read the four separate tickets by their purple-dot counts: one dot, then two, three, and four. On each ticket, match the current emblem to one of the two emblems and cross the divider to the other emblem. Only emblems inside tickets take part; free-floating emblems are distractors. After all four tickets, which emblem remains: circle, triangle, or square?
